summary: SNDL Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on its Q1 2026 financial and operational results. The release discusses net revenue of $195.9M (down 4.4% YoY), gross profit of $52.8M, operating loss of $(9.1)M, and cash flow details including share repurchases, changes in long-term investments, and a $2.9M payment for five retail store acquisitions. No material special-situation event is announced; this is a routine earnings report with investor conference call details. The filing does not trigger any special-situations category.
